note: Perfluoroalkyl substances used in lithography and cleaning are under phase-out pressure (EU REACH restriction proposal, EPA PFAS strategy). Material for fabs even if purchased from suppliers.
Take-back schemes, modular design, refurbish/remanufacture. EU Right-to-Repair and Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation.

topic: Supply-chain labor risk in Southeast Asia
note: EMS and semiconductor assembly concentrated in Vietnam, Malaysia, Thailand. Migrant-worker recruitment fees, forced-labor risk. RBA VAP + CSDDD driver.
Apple, Microsoft, Dell, HPE require suppliers to set SBTs and share PCFs. Missing this disqualifies Tier-1 contracts.
Gallium, germanium, rare earths subject to export controls (China → US/EU). Supply disruption risk for RF front-ends, power electronics, photonics.
Transboundary movement of e-waste under Basel Convention. WEEE compliance in EU. EPR schemes spreading.

topic: Fab water consumption in water-stressed regions
note: Semiconductor fabs consume 5–10M L/day. Siting in WRI Aqueduct tier-4+ regions (Taiwan, Arizona) presents business continuity + reputation risk.
Tin, tantalum, tungsten, gold from DRC and adjoining countries. OECD due diligence, SEC Dodd-Frank §1502, EU Conflict Minerals Regulation.

topic: Growth in data-center demand driving Scope 3 use-phase emissions
note: Generative AI workloads driving exponential server demand. Use-phase electricity > production embodied C for server SKUs within 18 months of deployment.

topic: Renewable PPA opportunities at manufacturing sites
note: Corporate PPAs in Vietnam, Malaysia, Thailand cheaper than grid since 2024. Immediate Scope 2 lever.
